source.title_on_document: Enhancing students’ Creativity with Generative Artificial Intelligence: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

paper_design_summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies on generative AI and students' creativity, according to its title. No abstract or full text could be read, so the number of included studies, the inclusion rule, the search dates, and the pooled estimates are not verified here.

studies.label: Systematic review and meta-analysis of generative-AI interventions on students' creativity

participants.who: Primary studies of students' creativity with generative AI, per the title; number of studies and participants not verified (no abstract or full text available)

ai_tool.name_model: Generative AI (as named in the title); specific tools not verified

task.description: Student creativity outcomes pooled across primary studies; task types not verified

eligibility.reason: Systematic review and meta-analysis (title), retained as synthesis context and excluded from core on the available metadata. No primary randomized people study was identified in the available metadata; whether the full paper contains one could not be checked. Crossref, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar provide no abstract; Europe PMC returns no record, and the publisher full-text page returned HTTP 403. The random-assignment, analyzed-participant-count, and output-scoring criteria remain unclear.

one_line_finding: A 2026 systematic review and meta-analysis of generative AI and students' creativity; its pooled numbers could not be checked because no abstract or full text was reachable.
open_questions: Obtain the full text (Taylor and Francis, closed access) to record the number of studies, effect sizes, search end date, inclusion rule, and pooled estimates.

Verify the unconfirmed lead in candidates.json: 19 empirical studies and an overall effect g = 0.908, moderated by the AI's role, the mode of student-AI interaction, and intervention duration (from a search-engine snippet, not from a primary record).
notes: Nothing in the synthesis block is filled, because no primary record with the numbers was reachable. Crossref lists 97 references, which the search lane mined for primary studies.
